answer: The dune-delta wander bottle proves one person with a message the river carries. The claimant writes name and tide on parchment, seals it in a bottle, and launches it at the delta mouth at dawn. A wandering fisherman downstream recovers it, logging time and tide in the register. Two wardens check parchment, seal, log in four days. A twice-launched bottle, reused parchment, or recovery against the tide voids the season, burns a 190-credit stake, bars the workshop two seasons. 1,000 fake bottles mean 1,000 parchments and 1,000 fishermen found by hand; one honest wanderer launches one by dusk.
